correctness.rationale: Exact residual-rank case split establishes transition probabilities. Finite rank counting gives stationary pi_0=P_infty; negative drift proves positive recurrence. The birth-death harmonic equation yields h_k=1/sum_{j<k} q^{j(j+2)}P_j^2, asymptotic q^{1-k^2}/P_infty^2. Kac renewal reward gives mean cycle length q/P_infty. IID cycle maxima and renewal LLN give Poisson intensity 1/P_infty. Summable dyadic upper and lower bounds plus Borel–Cantelli give M_N/sqrt(log_q N)->1 a.s. Independent exact-rational checks confirm finite formulas but are not used as infinite proofs.

value.rationale: The object is a natural streaming nested sequence of uniformly random square matrices; the maximum corank quantifies rare catastrophic rank defects across dependent times, not arbitrary unmotivated sample slices. The law identifies an exact nontrivial Poisson rare-level intensity and a sharp almost-sure growth scale. The coefficient requires dependence-aware excursion/hitting analysis and is not inferred from one-time corank tails alone.
